notes.title: Patch notes - Splodey v1.1.3
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

We added some small QoL improvements to some visual things in game, as well as responding to some user feedback regarding in-game timer events!

[list]
[*] Added visual marker for when player is off screen to help with visualization.
[*] Improved sound effects for loading into new levels
[*] New Spawn animation to to help better indicate when a level actually starts
[*] Level Timer now starts after the spawn animation has finished
[/list]

Other:
[list]
[*] Updated engined, minor bug fixes as a result of engine upgrade
[/list]

notes.title: V1.1.2
notes.notes:
-Added the top 10 players of the Splodey 10K Challenge to the credits
-3-22: Nerfed

notes.title: Patch notes - Splodey v1.1.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45027913/b32f7a22e23654d4fd3b24add4ffbc2cfa6e46d4.png[/img]

You've been throwing potions, we've been fixing bugs and adding new things to Splodey! We've just released a new patch, read on for all the changes. 

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new feature: The Snap Button! While holding the Snap Button, the potion angle gets snapped on virtual notches.
[*] Added a setting to adjust the amount of virtual notches for the snap button.
[*] Added a new leaderboard for All Exits.
[*] Added an indicator for when the player goes offscreen.
[*] Game timer no longer stops on death (Individual level timer is unaffected).
[*] Tied times now show the same rank on the leaderboards.
[*] Enabled Steam input for various controller types on default, which should fix the problem of sticks not working properly. 
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a few memory leaks.
[*] Fixed crumble blocks starting to crumble before fully landing on them.
[*] Fixed input tutorial image not disappearing when entering level exit.
[*] Fixed an issue with the player ignoring the exit portal when sending too hard.
[*] Fixed an issue with the scarf for skin "Shay".
[*] When beating a secret level, you will now either land in the level where you entered the cauldron from or land in the level select of the current world. 
[/list]
[b]Level Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] 2-7: Nerfed
[*] 3-19: Nerfed
[*] 3-21: Nerfed
[*] 3-25: Nerfed
[*] 4-4: Reworked
[*] 4-6: Minor Adjustments
[*] 5-16: Fixed an issue of fire being on the wrong side
[*] 5-24: Start Section Nerfed, End Section Buffed
[*] 5-25: Mid Section Buffed, End Section Nerfed
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.8
notes.notes:
-Save File Backups are getting created now
-Fixed an issue with the save file selector not showing in the save file select screen
-Fixed an issue with leaderboards showing the wrong page when switching leaderboards
-Fixed an issue with credits not showing when having "Auto Skip Level Clear" enabled
-Fixed an issue with highlighting the current level when entering the level select screen from the pause menu
-Fixed decorations in various levels

notes.title: V1.0.7
notes.notes:
-Added a new setting to change the gamepad axis deadzone
-You can see your final time in the credits now
-Fixed few achievements not unlocking properly
-Fixed smart mouse center when using windowed mode

notes.title: V1.0.6
notes.notes:
-Added a level select button to the pause menu
-Fixed a vram leak which was causing graphics card drivers to crash
-Fixed the task icon not appearing when launching the game in fullscreen/borderless
-Fixed player not spawning infront of the first portal when creating a new save file
-Fixed a pause menu issue in 4-23
-3-21: Minor revert from V1.0.5

notes.title: V1.0.5
notes.notes:
-Few performance optimizations
-Timer doesnt pause in the pause menu anymore (to prevent pause menu buffering abuse in speedruns)
-2-16: Fixed camera
-2-19: Adjusted an offscreen collider
-3-21: Minor nerf
-3-B is a bit easier to find now
-4-11: Soul is slightly easier to get

notes.title: V1.0.4
notes.notes:
-Added a new setting "Graphics Quality" in the options menu. Setting it to mid or low will especially improve the performance of world 3.
-Fixed an issue with saving keys when unbinding them
-You can now unbind the gamepad button B from the binding "Menu Back"
-Added a tutorial for the reset action in 1-2
-Parachute wobble is not random anymore
-Level 4-15 and 4-23: Minor nerf

We are aware of game crashes/freezes on a few systems and are investigating the issue! Updating graphics card drivers seem to solve the issue in some cases.

notes.title: V1.0.3
notes.notes:
-Fixed an issue with re-entering the options menu
-Levels 3-10,3-25 and 4-20: Minor nerfs
-Level 1-D: Replaced keys (that dont do anything!) with switches 
-Fixed a pause menu issue in 3-25
-Fixed a visual issue with leaderboards

Thanks for all the support guys! This release has been amazing <3

notes.title: Speedrun Splodey for a chance at $10,000!
notes.notes:
[b]Attention speedrunners and content creators: your chance to win $10,000 starts now![/b]

We’re running a Splodey speedrun challenge where the entire prize pool goes to the champion. This competition runs now to June 18, so you have two weeks to rack up your fastest run possible. 

It’s simple, stream or post video of your fastest complete game run and upload it to [url=www.speedrun.com]www.speedrun.com[/url]. You need to complete the entire BASE game of Splodey - this means our 4 core Worlds, totalling 100 levels. Secret levels and the bonus World are NOT needed. 

Full details, rules, submission form, and leaderboard can be found at: [url=https://www.speedrun.com/challenges/vd39ep5n-Splodey-the-splodey-10k-challenge]https://www.speedrun.com/challenges/vd39ep5n-Splodey-the-splodey-10k-challenge[/url].

Good luck, everyone!

notes.title: Splodey is Live!
notes.notes:
[b]Ready. Set. SPLODE![/b]

Splodey, the platformer without a jump button, is now live! And we’re running a discount to $9.80 for the next week. 

This platformer ditches the traditional jump mechanic for twin-stick controls and exploding potions that you’ll use to clear obstacles and propel yourself across hazards, gaps, and more. It’s seriously hard too - you’ll need to utilize skill, momentum, and speed to beat levels and beat our own best times. 

[previewyoutube=Ot0MagwxASM;full][/previewyoutube]

We want your feedback here on Steam too. Send It Studios is a small team - we’re three friends, streamers, and speedrunners and this is our first title ever. So please tell us what you like, what you don’t like, and what you want to see in the future for Splodey. 

To connect with other Splodey players, head on over to the Mad Mushroom [url=www.discord.gg/madmushroomgg]Discord[/url]. Oh, and if you’re a streamer, check out [url=https://www.speedrun.com/challenges/vd39ep5n-MetaTest-splodey-10-000-speedrun-challenge]Mizkif’s Splodey $10k Challenge[/url], a two-week speedrun competition where the fastest run will win $10,000. 

[b]Now go on and get to splodin’![/b]
